name: walkthrough-studio
description: Agent-driven toolkit for Screen-Studio-style walkthrough and tour videos of any web app or website, with captions or an ElevenLabs voiceover: studio mode (isolated clone of an owned app) or site mode (any URL), Playwright recorder with an action log, HyperFrames edit with a drawn pointer, camera and event-anchored captions, generated music, model-tiered review agents, and a delivery package.
